label: ENDLESS_TEMPORAL_DURATION_2, contrast…: Duration with an unending succession of earlier and later…
definition: Duration with an unending succession of earlier and later moments: in a supplied preorder of times, temporal presence holds at some moment and every present moment has a strictly later present moment. A beginning is allowed. Ordinary succession does not require changing life-states. No convex support, total coverage, total order, or past-unboundedness is required.
note: Stipulated contrast, clarified by owner endpoint decision on 2026-11-09; no temporal model or perpetually existing real thing is asserted. Temporal presence is a primitive input interpreted as the selected subject being present at that time; its applicability and the temporal adequacy of the supplied preorder remain open. Strict comparison excludes equal/equivalent moments; no immediate successor or discrete timeline is assumed. A pinned account would be needed for historical attribution. The distinction is motivated by q.10 a.1; attribution deferred. See corpus/definitions/endless-temporal-duration-audit.md. Existing EndlessLife permits finite timelines and remains unchanged.
